description: Repairs r-sql-1/agg-occur: the 'x' row of TX failed every variant at open. Asks what rows and order result when the same aggregate over a conversion appears in SELECT, HAVING and ORDER BY (ascending, descending, HAVING only), over TXC where every value converts (1, 1, 3, 1, 2), over TX with its 'x' row excluded by WHERE t <> 'x', and over unfiltered TX for the error phase. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-sql1 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
